cue_word_check_T1_contradicted.meaning: mechanical upper bound on mode errors among contradicted T1 claims

reasoner_vs_recheck.note: Encoding fidelity: does the reasoner decide exactly what the rules state? Not construct validity. Both sides read the same git objects through different code.

hermit_vs_pellet.note: Pellet 2.3.1 throws InternalReasonerException ('Adding type to a pruned node') while classifying the claims TBox, as it did for the WP1 TBoxes; HermiT is therefore the only complete decision procedure here. Pellet's `explain` (instance check) still succeeds for most claims; see explanations.

notes.T3_T4: grep hits flag a signature or alias gap; zero hits corroborate. Repos above 5000 tracked files are grepped over config-like and source files only.
notes.T2: GitHub commits API counts all commits touching the path (merges included), so it can exceed the first-parent non-merge count.
notes.T5: A CI file invoking a script reported undefined flags a possible false contradiction or a broken CI.

drift.caveat: Drifted/born-wrong are inferred by HermiT from the two measurements; the flip commit uses the independent re-check as bisection predicate and assumes a single flip.

alpha_line_level.note: every manifest line is a unit, so agreement on 'no claim' counts: an upper bound; the union-of-keys alpha above is the lower bound

extraction_agreement.caveat: Presence alpha codes union-of-keys presence per model; it approximates unitizing alpha_u and is deflated by singleton units, so pairwise F1 is reported alongside it.

strict_no_quote_repair.note: same pipeline but claims without a model-supplied quote are rejected instead of repaired from the subject's line
